For every employee with a salary return `name` and the running salary total `run` ordered by salary ascending, with the default window frame (rows with an equal salary are peers).

Tables: `dept(id, name)` and `emp(id, name, dept_id, salary, mgr_id)`. Write a single `SELECT`.
